name.zh: 红牛移动 Red Bull MOBILE Data

tagline.en: A1 Austria-powered travel eSIM: 100MB free base data plus a community-confirmed Austrian number
tagline.zh: 奥地利 A1 网络旅行 eSIM：官方送 100MB 流量，社区实测附带奥地利号码

description.en: Red Bull MOBILE Data is an app-based travel eSIM operated by A1 Telekom Austria AG, covering 100+ countries with per-GB pricing (Europe from €2/GB, regional rates vary). Officially the line is data-only: new users get the first 100MB free, no basic fees, no subscription, and your existing number stays untouched. Community guides (2025-2026, multiple independent sources) discovered the practical bonus: installing the eSIM assigns an Austrian (+43) mobile number that receives registration and verification SMS, reportedly valid 365 days at no cost and without KYC — and promo codes (e.g. REDBULL1GBFREE, TRAVELDEALZ) stack a further 1GB for a combined ~1.1GB free allowance.

details.en:
## How to claim (community route)

Download "Red Bull MOBILE Data: eSIM" (App Store / Google Play, publisher A1 Telekom Austria AG), register an account in-app, tap Activate eSIM and install the profile. The phone needs native eSIM support to open the app at all; the profile can alternatively be installed via eSIM-capable adapter cards. After the activation SMS arrives, the Austrian (+43) number appears on iPhone automatically; Android users may need to call their local carrier's service line echo to read the number out, per community guides. Promo codes are entered under Settings > Promocodes.

## Why people keep it installed

The Austrian number receives registration and verification SMS for mainstream platforms, which community guides rate as more reliable than virtual numbers from some competitors. The 100MB base doubles as a bootstrap line for ESTK/eSIM-adapter users who need connectivity to download further eSIM profiles. Data exits via A1 Austria with a Vienna IP.

## The catches

The number is an undocumented emergent feature, not a contractual promise: in December 2025 forum users reported SMS reception breaking mid-validity, and there is no SLA to appeal to. The eSIM can be installed only once — deleting the profile burns it. Keep-alive guidance from the community: avoid consuming the 100MB base data, as it is the preferred bucket for keeping the line active. Mainland-China iPhones without native eSIM are excluded by the app's device check.
details.zh:
## 领取路径（社区实测）

下载「Red Bull MOBILE Data: eSIM」（App Store / Google Play，发行方 A1 Telekom Austria AG），App 内注册账号，点 Activate eSIM 安装配置文件。手机需原生支持 eSIM 才能打开 App；配置也可装到支持 eSIM 的转接实体卡上。收到激活短信后，iPhone 会自动显示奥地利（+43）号码；社区攻略称安卓用户可能需要拨打本网运营商客服热线，通过回显语音读出号码。兑换码在 Settings > Promocodes 输入。

## 为什么值得常驻

奥地利号码可接收主流平台的注册验证短信，社区攻略评价其可靠性优于部分竞品的虚拟号码。100MB 基础流量对 ESTK/eSIM 转接卡用户还是引导线——下载其他 eSIM 配置时需要联网。数据出口走 A1 奥地利，维也纳 IP。

## 注意事项

号码是未写进条款的隐性福利，不是合同承诺：2025 年 12 月论坛用户反映有效期内短信接收突然失效，且无 SLA 可申诉。eSIM 只能安装一次——删除配置文件即作废。社区保号建议：不要消耗那 100MB 基础流量，它是维持号码活跃的首选计费桶。不支持 eSIM 的国行 iPhone 会被 App 设备检查直接挡住。
